name: WD-Regularized Loss
definition: A training objective that augments the Wasserstein Distance (WD) perceptual loss with a lightly weighted version of the original 3DGS pixel-level loss to avoid artifacts in regions with constrained splat counts or small numbers of training views.
summary: WD-Regularized Loss combines Wasserstein perceptual loss with a lightly weighted original pixel loss to balance fidelity and sharpness in 3D Gaussian Splatting.
